# YellowPages.com Business Leads, Ratings & Reviews Scraper

YellowPages.com is a large US local-business directory. This actor turns keyword searches, category pages, pasted Yellow Pages URLs, or a list of business profiles into structured records: contact details, address, rating, review count, categories, hours, geo coordinates, services, payment methods, social links, and optional customer reviews.

## What this actor does

- Runs one or many keyword searches against one or many US locations and ZIP codes.
- Browses a category-and-location page, including Yellow Pages' `open-24-hours` category filter.
- Replays pasted search-result URLs, category URLs, and business profile URLs; the URL type is detected automatically.
- Enriches results from each business's profile page: full hours, description, email, geo coordinates, services/products, brands, payment methods, associations, social links, neighborhoods, ownership, amenities, languages, accreditation, and founding year.
- Collects customer reviews page by page, with a per-business cap.
- Filters on minimum rating, review count, years in business, years with Yellow Pages, website, email, open-now status, and open-24-hours status.
- Keeps or drops sponsored cards, and keeps or drops closed businesses.
- Omits fields the source did not publish — no `null`, empty strings, or empty arrays in the output.

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `search` | `search`, `category`, `businessDetail`, or `startUrls`. |
| `searchTerms` | string | `restaurants` | Keyword for `mode=search`; blank lists every business at the location. |
| `searchQueries` | array | – | Extra keywords, cross-joined with every location. |
| `geoLocationTerms` | string | `New York, NY` | City + state, ZIP code, or neighborhood for `mode=search`. |
| `geoLocations` | array | – | Extra locations, cross-joined with every search term. |
| `categorySlug` | string | – | Category slug for `mode=category`, e.g. `plumbers`. |
| `locationSlug` | string | – | Location slug for `mode=category`, e.g. `new-york-ny`. |
| `categoryFilter` | string | `none` | `none` or `open-24-hours`; applies the site's category filter. |
| `startUrls` | array | – | Search, category, or `/mip/` profile URLs for `mode=startUrls`. |
| `detailUrls` | array | – | Business profile URLs for `mode=businessDetail`. |
| `sortBy` | string | `default` | `default`, `distance`, `average_rating`, or `name`. |
| `maxItems` | integer | `30` | Hard cap on emitted records, 1–1000. |
| `maxPages` | integer | `0` | Pages per search/category; `0` follows the source until it runs out. |
| `startPage` | integer | `1` | First results page, useful when resuming. |
| `fetchBusinessDetails` | boolean | `false` | Visit every result's profile page for enrichment. |
| `includeReviews` | boolean | `false` | Add customer reviews; turns on profile-page fetches. |
| `maxReviewsPerBusiness` | integer | `10` | Review cap; `0` collects every review served. |
| `maxDetailFetches` | integer | `150` | Cap on profile-page fetches; `0` means no cap. |
| `minRating` | string | – | Minimum stars: `1`, `1.5`, `2`, `2.5`, `3`, `3.5`, `4`, `4.5`, or `5`. |
| `minReviewCount` | integer | – | Minimum reviews; unrated businesses are kept. |
| `minYearsInBusiness` | integer | – | Minimum years in business; businesses without the badge are kept. |
| `minYearsWithYellowPages` | integer | – | Minimum years with Yellow Pages; businesses without the badge are kept. |
| `hasWebsiteOnly` | boolean | `false` | Keep only businesses with a website. |
| `hasEmailOnly` | boolean | `false` | Keep only businesses with a public email; enables enrichment. |
| `openNowOnly` | boolean | `false` | Keep only businesses shown as open at scrape time. |
| `open24HoursOnly` | boolean | `false` | Keep only businesses whose status or hours say open 24 hours. |
| `includeAds` | boolean | `true` | Keep sponsored cards above the organic results. |
| `includeClosedBusinesses` | boolean | `true` | Keep businesses the site marks as closed. |

### Search example

```json
{
  "mode": "search",
  "searchTerms": "plumbers",
  "searchQueries": ["electricians"],
  "geoLocationTerms": "New York, NY",
  "geoLocations": ["10005"],
  "sortBy": "average_rating",
  "minRating": "4",
  "maxItems": 100
}
```

### Category example

```json
{
  "mode": "category",
  "categorySlug": "hair-salons",
  "locationSlug": "los-angeles-ca",
  "categoryFilter": "open-24-hours",
  "fetchBusinessDetails": true,
  "maxItems": 40
}
```

### Pasted URLs example

```json
{
  "mode": "startUrls",
  "startUrls": [
    "https://www.yellowpages.com/search?search_terms=pizza&geo_location_terms=10001",
    "https://www.yellowpages.com/chicago-il/dentists",
    "https://www.yellowpages.com/new-york-ny/mip/lombardis-531159833"
  ],
  "maxItems": 60
}
```

### Profile + reviews example

```json
{
  "mode": "businessDetail",
  "detailUrls": [
    "https://www.yellowpages.com/yonkers-ny/mip/roto-rooter-plumbing-water-cleanup-495364349"
  ],
  "includeReviews": true,
  "maxReviewsPerBusiness": 20
}
```

## Output per business

Identity and contact:

- `businessId`, `listingId`, `name`, `businessUrl`
- `phone`, `extraPhones[]`, `website`, `email`, `additionalEmails[]`
- `isAd`, `listingType`, `source`, `searchTerm`, `searchLocation`

Address and location:

- `streetAddress`, `city`, `state`, `zipCode`, `country`, `fullAddress`
- `latitude`, `longitude`, `areaServed`
- `neighborhoods[]`, `location`

Reputation and categories:

- `rating`, `reviewCount`, `yearsInBusiness`, `yearsWithYellowPages`
- `categories[]`, `primaryCategory`, `categorySlugs[]`
- `openStatus`, `hours[]`, `openingHours[]`, `snippet`, `couponText`
- `reviews[]` with `author`, `rating`, `date`, `body`, `helpfulCount`, `response`

Profile enrichment:

- `description`, `generalInfo`, `slogan`, `extraLines[]`
- `servicesProducts[]`, `brands[]`, `paymentMethods[]`
- `associations[]`, `accreditation`, `ownership`, `businessHistory`
- `socialLinks[]`, `otherLinks[]`, `amenities[]`, `languages[]`
- `aka[]`, `otherInformation`, `freeEstimates`, `servesCuisine[]`, `foundingYear`

Every record also has `recordType: "business"` and `scrapedAt`.

## Use cases

- Build local lead lists by trade and metro, then qualify on rating, reviews, and years in business.
- Enrich a CRM's business rows with Yellow Pages phone, website, email, hours, and geo coordinates.
- Compare a category's rating distribution or review volume across cities.
- Monitor a set of profile URLs and review counts over time.
- Replay a search URL a colleague built in the Yellow Pages UI.

## FAQ

**Is this affiliated with YellowPages.com?**
No. It reads publicly available Yellow Pages pages and is not affiliated with YP Holdings.

**Why are some fields missing?**
Yellow Pages only publishes some fields for some businesses. Email, years-with-Yellow-Pages, payment methods, brands, associations, amenities, and reviews are all conditional. The actor omits what the source does not show rather than inventing a value.

**When do I get reviews?**
Set `includeReviews` to `true`. Reviews come from the profile page, ten at a time, and the actor follows review pages until `maxReviewsPerBusiness` is reached or the source runs out.

**When do I get hours and geo coordinates?**
All the enrichment fields require a profile-page fetch. Set `fetchBusinessDetails` to `true` for search or category runs, or use `businessDetail`/`startUrls` with profile URLs. `includeReviews` and `hasEmailOnly` also turn on enrichment automatically.

**Does `open24HoursOnly` use a Yellow Pages filter?**
In category mode you can use the server-side `categoryFilter=open-24-hours` option. Everywhere else the actor applies the same check to each result's status and hours, so it may scan more pages.

**Why does a run stop before `maxItems`?**
Either the source ran out of results or `maxPages`/`maxDetailFetches` was reached. The status message reports the shortfall. Increase `maxPages`, raise `maxDetailFetches`, or split a large market into ZIP codes or neighborhoods.

**Why does `startUrls` reject a URL?**
It accepts Yellow Pages search-result, category, and `/mip/` profile URLs. A bare listing ID is not a profile URL and cannot be resolved by the site. Use the full profile URL or search by the business name.

**Which locations are supported?**
US locations only: `City, ST`, 5-digit ZIP codes, and neighborhoods. YellowPages.com does not cover Canada or the UK.

**Can I exclude sponsored cards?**
Yes. Set `includeAds` to `false`. The output marks sponsored rows with `isAd: true` and `listingType: "ad"`.

## Limitations

- Yellow Pages does not publish a public API, and a listing ID alone does not resolve to a profile. A profile URL needs its location slug.
- Some profile fields are only present when the business owner supplied them; no actor can fill them for every business.
- The site limits how deep a single query paginates. For very large categories, split by ZIP code, neighborhood, or sub-category.
- Photos, logos, and thumbnails are served from a Cloudflare-protected image host; the actor does not emit those URLs because they cannot be verified from a clean environment.
- Yellow Pages can rate-limit or challenge automated traffic. The actor rotates proxy sessions and retries, and reports a clear status message instead of returning partial garbage.
